review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This position combines hands-on systems administration, advanced technical support, security operations, and project work across Microsoft 365, endpoint management, networking, and cloud infrastructure. Support Global Relay administration and related retention or archiving requirements in coordination with designated business and compliance owners. Evaluate technologies such as Virtual Desktop Infrastructure and Azure Virtual Desktop based on business needs, security, cost, and support requirements. Qualifications What You Bring At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in systems administration, IT infrastructure, or a related hands-on technical role. Hands-on experience with Windows 11, Windows Autopilot, Dell hardware, endpoint configuration, and device lifecycle management.
